help: Append a mode: unix permissions 755, permissions 4755 or rwxr-xr-x. Edit the query to change the mode; Enter copies the explanation. Parse only; no file access.
error.syntax: Enter 3–4 octal digits or exactly 9 permission characters; commands and paths are not accepted.
error.octal: Octal permissions require 3–4 digits from 0 to 7 (0000–7777).
error.symbolic: Use rwx positions: s/S only for owner/group execute; t/T only for others execute.
meaning: r/w/x: file read/write/execute; directory list/modify entries/search. Effective access also depends on ACLs, mount options and OS rules.
special.setuid: setuid (4000): on supported executable files, execution can use the file owner’s effective UID; subject to OS rules.
special.setgid: setgid (2000): supported executable files can use the file group’s effective GID; directories can pass their group to new entries.
special.sticky: sticky (1000): on directories, removal/rename is restricted to the entry owner, directory owner or a privileged user.
special.case: s/t include execute; S/T mean the special bit is set without execute.
localOnly: Parsed locally; no chmod was executed and no file was accessed.
